n0.source: Margueron, Hoffmann Casali, Gulminelli, PRC 97, 025805 (2018): n_sat = 0.155 +- 0.005; author's EMPIRICAL n0_fm3='0.16' (verification/nvg_saturation_recalibration.py:59-70)

EA.source: Margueron et al. 2018: E_sat = -15.8 +- 0.3; Dutra et al. PRC 85, 035201 (2012); author's binding_MeV='-16'

K.source: Shlomo, Kolomietz, Colo, EPJA 30, 23 (2006): K = 240 +- 20; Garg & Colo, PPNP 101, 55 (2018); author's K_window_MeV=[220,260]

ystar.source: RMF Dirac effective mass 0.55-0.75 (Dutra et al. PRC 90, 055203 (2014); Glendenning 1997) = author's EMPIRICAL mstar_over_M_window=[0.6,0.7]; 0.75-0.93 is the author's own design grid Y_GRID (nvg_saturation_recalibration.py:75, nvg_forward_beta_eos_audit.py:44); declared window = union, subject to global stability of U

Q0.source: Margueron et al. 2018: Q_sat = 300 +- 400; Dutra et al. 2012 Skyrme systematics -700..-200; Cai & Chen PRC 95, 024302 (2017): -306 +- 400. Role: fixes a5 ONLY when the quartic q(z) is not globally stable; otherwise a5 = 0 and Q0 is a forward output

L.source: Lattimer & Lim 2013: 40.5-61.9; Li & Han 2013: 58.9 +- 16; Oertel et al. 2017: 58.7 +- 28.1; author's L_window_MeV=[35,65]

scenario_B_J_design_MeV.source: verification/nvg_prex_crex_external_consistency_probe.py:128-129 (T_CONTACT 12.644118 + j_bar 11.136016); theory-internal identification replacing the empirical J window

structural_principles: U(y) = z^2 q(z), z = y^2-1 (vacuum y=1 with U(1)=U'(1)=0); global stability = q(z) >= 0 for all z >= -1 (polynomial_vacuum_bound, source_complete_scaling_saturation_audit.py)
vector energy C_v n^2/(2 y^2), C_v = (mu0 - E_F) y*^2/n0 fixed by (y*, n0, E/A) (inverse_potential_jet); no vector self-interaction
linear scalar mass m = M y, M = 939 MeV; rho term C_rho n^2 delta^2/8, C0 = 8 (J - T)/n0 at n0
running of the isovector contact: power law C(n) = C0 (n/n0)^gamma, gamma = (L - L_kin)/(3 (J - T)) - 1 [class 1], or Pade C(n) = C0/(1 + alpha (n/n0 - 1)), alpha = -gamma [class 2]
beta equilibrium n p e mu with charge neutrality; thermodynamically consistent pressure P_rho = eps_rho (1 + n C'(n)/C); the author's P_rho = eps_rho is the labelled 'authorP' variant

scalar completion rule (declared): quartic if globally stable (a5 = 0, Q0 forward output); else quintic with a5 fixed by the declared Q0; else 'no_stable_model'. Separate structural class (counted, not from a window): minimal sextic completion a6_min

stellar validity: causality max c_s^2 < 1 on the stellar branch; dP/dn > 0 above the crust match; M_max an interior maximum of M(P_c) within the table (x <= 15); 'strict' additionally requires the tracked scalar branch to be the global minimum of eps_N(n, delta, y) over y on the stellar branch

author_polytrope.source: verification/nvg_forward_tov_heldout_audit.py:37-38 (P_MATCH, GAMMA_CRUST); eps = eps_match (P/p_match)^(1/Gamma) below p_match; surface event P = 1e-4

sly.source: Read, Lackey, Owen, Friedman, Phys. Rev. D 79, 124032 (2009), Table II (piecewise-polytrope fit to the SLy EOS of Douchin & Haensel 2001, A&A 380, 151), eqs. (5)-(7) for eps(rho) with a_0 = 0
sly.conventions: P -> piece via the lower piece's pressure at each dividing density; rho = m_B n; matching: 'eps' = eps-continuity root on the monotone core tail (spline convention), 'P' = P-continuity at x_m with the Hinderer jump condition (Damour & Nagar 2009 PRD 80 084035; Hinderer, Lackey, Lang, Read 2010 PRD 81 123016: y(r_d+) = y(r_d-) - 4 pi r_d^3 Deps/(m + 4 pi r_d^3 P))

Mmax_J0740_Fonseca2021.source: Fonseca et al. 2021 ApJL 915 L12: M=2.08+-0.07 -> pass if M_max>=2.01

interpretation.corner_RU: Угловая точка (y*=0.83, Q0=+55, K=260, n0=0.17, E/A=-15.5, L=35, J=34) — звёздно-отобранная (post hoc), помечена star_selected_post_hoc; её прохождение 2σ при корке SLy (eps-непрерывная сшивка) и провал 1σ по R(1.44) — описание, не свидетельство.
interpretation.author_points_RU: Четыре авторские точки (квартика, a5=0): при согласованном давлении и корке SLy M_max = 1.79/1.69/1.45/1.00 для y* = 0.87/0.88/0.90/0.93 — ни одна не достигает 2.01 M_sun; авторская конвенция P_rho = eps_rho с коркой SLy не допускает eps-непрерывной сшивки (материя легче SLy при любом давлении), резерв — P-сшивка с инверсией плотности.
interpretation.multiplicity_RU: Множественность классов посчитана: 2 скалярных варианта × 2 бега × 2 сценария + 2 варианта авторского давления = 10 ключей EOS на образец; корка — 2 модели (политропа автора, SLy) × конвенции сшивки.
interpretation.evidence_RU: Вес свидетельства 0.0: forward-следствие объявленных окон; флаги pass/fail описательные; статус NOT_ESTABLISHED для любого утверждения о согласии с нейтронными звёздами, если оно опирается на звёздно-отобранную точку или на выбор корки.
